info.name: BuboIQ Back Office API
info.description:
Production API collection for BuboIQ Super Admin Console. All endpoints require super_admin JWT token.

**Setup:**
1. Set `{{baseUrl}}` to your Supabase project URL
2. Set `{{adminToken}}` to your super admin JWT (get from Auth.getSession() after signing in)
3. Run requests to test admin operations

**Security:** All operations are audited. Check Compliance tab after running mutations.

request.description:
Fetch all organizations with billing status, health, and trial info.

**Returns:** Empty array if no orgs exist (no mock data).

**Response:**
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "name": "Acme Corp",
      "tier": "Pro",
      "status": "active",
      "seats": 10,
      "created_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "last_active_at": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z",
      "stripe_customer_id": "cus_xxx",
      "trial_ends_at": null
    }
  ]
}
```

Change organization tier. Creates audit log entry.

**Body:**
```json
{
  "tier": "Starter" | "Growth" | "Pro" | "Enterprise"
}
```

**Success Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Tier changed from Starter to Pro"
}
```

**Audit:** Check Compliance tab after running.

Extend trial period by specified days.

**Body:**
```json
{
  "days": 7 | 14 | 30 | <any positive integer>
}
```

**Success Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "new_trial_end": "2024-02-15T00:00:00Z",
  "message": "Trial extended by 14 days"
}
```

**Error if no finance record:**
```json
{
  "error": "No billing record found for this organization",
  "hint": "Ensure Stripe webhook has created finance_ops entry"
}
```

Disable organization (soft delete). Users cannot sign in.

**Success Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Organization Acme Corp has been disabled"
}
```

**To re-enable:** Run SQL: `UPDATE companies SET settings = jsonb_set(settings, '{suspended}', 'false') WHERE id = 'org-id';`

Generate short-lived impersonation token (5 minutes).

**Success Response:**
```json
{
  "token": "impersonate_xxx",
  "org_id": "uuid",
  "org_name": "Acme Corp",
  "expires_in": 300
}
```

**Usage:** Store token in sessionStorage and reload page to impersonate.

Get real-time billing metrics.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "data": {
    "mrr": 125000,
    "failed_payments": 3,
    "trials_expiring": 12,
    "invoices": []
  },
  "message": "Connect Stripe webhook to see invoice details"
}
```

**MRR Calculation:** Sum of `finance_ops.mrr_cents` where `status = 'active'`

Retry failed payment via Stripe API.

**Success Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Payment retry initiated. Check Stripe dashboard for status.",
  "hint": "Implement Stripe API call to enable real payment retry"
}
```

**Note:** Requires Stripe API integration (currently returns stub response).

Get open support tickets across all orgs.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "org_name": "Acme Corp",
      "title": "Unable to connect to remote session",
      "status": "open",
      "source": "in-app",
      "created_at": "2024-01-15T10:00:00Z",
      "streak_box_url": "https://app.streak.com/..."
    }
  ]
}
```

**Empty State:**
```json
{
  "data": [],
  "message": "No open support tickets. New requests will appear here."
}
```

Add internal note to support ticket.

**Body:**
```json
{
  "note": "<string 1-2000 chars>"
}
```

**Success Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Note added to ticket"
}
```

**Audit:** Creates audit log entry.

Enable/disable feature flag or set rollout percentage.

**Body (optional fields):**
```json
{
  "enabled": true | false,
  "rollout_percent": 0-100
}
```

**Success Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Feature flag coming_soon_mode updated"
}
```

**Audit:** Creates audit log entry.

Generate compliance evidence CSV from audit logs.

**Body:**
```json
{
  "type": "audit_log" | "access_review" | "admin_actions"
}
```

**Success Response:** CSV file download
```
Timestamp,Action,Actor Email,Target Org ID
2024-01-15T10:30:00Z,change_tier,admin@buboiq.com,org-123
```

**Error if no audit data:**
```json
{
  "error": "No audit data available for evidence export",
  "hint": "Perform admin actions to generate audit trail"
}
```

**Audit:** Creates audit log entry for evidence generation.

Check server health (no auth required).

**Response:**
```json
{
  "status": "ok",
  "timestamp": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z",
  "version": "2.0.0",
  "services": {
    "database": "ok",
    "email": "warning",
    "storage": "ok"
  },
  "initialized": true
}
```
